title: Modifying Comparatives: a lot, far, a little, slightly

vocabulary.meaning_en: the form of an adjective used to compare two things: bigger, more expensive
how much; the amount of difference
vocabulary.example: "A lot" and "slightly" show the degree of difference.

vocabulary.meaning_en: much; by a big amount (before a comparative)
vocabulary.example: He is a lot bigger than his brother.

vocabulary.meaning_en: by a big amount (before a comparative)
vocabulary.example: This book is much different from that one.
This phone is far more expensive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: by a big amount (after the comparative or with superlatives)

vocabulary.example: The red one is a little more expensive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: by a small amount; a little
vocabulary.example: Sill is slightly smaller than Mr. E.
I feel a little more confident in English now.
This hotel is more expensive than that one.

fine_lines.title: big difference vs small difference
fine_lines.explanation_ar: للفرق الكبير: a lot, much, far + صيغة المقارنة. للفرق الصغير: a little, slightly + صيغة المقارنة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Big difference: a lot, much, far + comparative. Small difference: a little, slightly + comparative.

examples.sentence: My new flat is a lot bigger than my old one.
Today is slightly warmer than yesterday.

fine_lines.title: far more vs by far
fine_lines.explanation_ar: far تأتي قبل صيغة المقارنة (far more expensive, far happier). by far تأتي بعدها (larger by far) أو مع صيغة التفضيل (by far the best).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Far" goes before the comparative (far more expensive, far happier). "By far" goes after it (larger by far) or with superlatives (by far the best).

examples.sentence: This bag is bigger by far.

expressions.example: Toronto is a lot bigger than my town.
This book is slightly different from what I usually read.

expressions.meaning_en: a bit more sure of yourself
expressions.example: After the lesson, I felt a little more confident.

grammar.title: Comparatives (review)
grammar.explanation_ar: للصفات القصيرة نضيف er (bigger, smaller)، وللطويلة نستعمل more (more expensive)، ثم than.
grammar.explanation_en: Short adjectives take -er (bigger, smaller); long ones take "more" (more expensive), then "than".
examples: He is bigger than his brother.
This is more expensive than that.

grammar.title: Big difference: a lot / much / far + comparative
grammar.explanation_ar: نضع a lot أو much أو far قبل صيغة المقارنة لنبيّن أن الفرق كبير. لا نقول bigger a lot.
grammar.explanation_en: Put a lot, much or far before the comparative to show a big difference. Don't say "bigger a lot".
examples: He is a lot bigger than his brother.
This phone is far more expensive.

grammar.title: by far: after the comparative
grammar.explanation_ar: by far تأتي بعد صيغة المقارنة، بعكس a lot و far: He is larger by far.
grammar.explanation_en: "By far" comes after the comparative, unlike "a lot" and "far": He is larger by far.

grammar.title: Small difference: a little / slightly + comparative
grammar.explanation_ar: نضع a little أو slightly قبل صيغة المقارنة لنبيّن أن الفرق صغير.
grammar.explanation_en: Put a little or slightly before the comparative to show a small difference.
examples: The red bag is a little more expensive.
Sill is slightly smaller than Mr. E.

questions.question: "He is ___ bigger than his brother." (big difference)
questions.explanation_ar: فرق كبير قبل المقارنة: a lot.
questions.explanation_en: Big difference before the comparative: a lot.
